lanes.summary: The diff cleanly implements PMAT-3471 (ONT-2b) and passes all requirements in the review brief. It introduces contracts/ontology.yaml declaring the ontology's symbols, roles, and entities. The sigma gate validates that the corpus complies, throwing exit 3 for malformations and rejecting unapproved entity types or roles. The symbol-level formal: checks ignore the `prose: true` opt-outs appropriately, and the formal_prose shrink-only ratchet ensures no new technical debt is introduced silently. Every measured test and claim aligns with the ticket, and the identified defect where `ontology.yaml` was counted as a contract was properly caught and resolved. There is nothing in the diff that refutes the ticket.

PMAT-3471 (ONT-2b: Σ — contracts/ontology.yaml with entity_types and extractors; symbol-level check on formal:) diff audit complete. All ticket requirements, acceptance criteria, and receipt claims were read and independently measured:

1. Σ integrity and schema (contracts/ontology.yaml): Declares 9 concepts, 6 roles, 66 operator/function symbols, 1 world, 3 agents, 7 entity types, 7 extractors, 3 not_expressible keys, and a complete readers map claiming every populated key (measured via yaml parse).
2. Σ loader and malformed-Σ handling (crates/aprender-contracts/src/ontology/sigma.rs): Parses Σ and enforces the four malformed-Σ classes via `Sigma::check_integrity`, returning `SigmaError` mapped to exit code 3 (`error:`). 10/10 unit tests pass.
3. The sigma gate (crates/aprender-contracts/src/lint/sigma_gate.rs & sigma_symbols.rs): Parses raw YAML and checks PV-ONT-001 (entity.type in Σ), PV-ONT-002 (relations in Σ roles), PV-ONT-003 (undeclared operator glyphs unless explicit `prose: true`), and PV-ONT-004 (formal_prose ratchet). Symbol check restricts to non-ASCII non-alphabetic operator glyphs while leaving applied identifiers to ONT-3a. 15/15 unit tests pass.
4. CLI --gate execution and ONT-6 lattice: `pv lint --gate <name>` runs single gates, reporting `Pass` (exit 0), corpus violations (exit 1 `reject:`), missing Σ (exit 2 `decline:`), and malformed Σ (exit 3 `error:`). All 8 integration tests in `tests/ont2b_sigma_gate.rs` pass.
5. Gate arming & baseline (contracts/lint-baseline.json): Armed gates monotonically increased from 8 to 9 with `sigma` armed. `formal_prose` baseline established at measured 1464. Full `pv lint contracts/` exits 0.
6. Real corpus and mutation testing: `make contracts` passed cleanly (1579 engine tests passed, census 1793, provenance check ok, readme synced). Mutation removing `prose: true` failed gate at exit 1 (PV-ONT-003); mutation dropping a role failed test at exit 101. Clippy `-D warnings` is clean.

No refutations identified. Verdict is PASS.
